title: Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure (LAAC)
item_service_description:
<p><strong> A.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;General</strong></p>  
   
<p>Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), an irregular heartbeat, are at an increased risk of stroke. The left atrial appendage (LAA) is a tubular structure that opens into the left atrium and has been shown to be one potential source for blood clots that can cause strokes. While thinning the blood with anticoagulant medications has been proven to prevent strokes, percutaneous LAA closure (LAAC) has been studied as a non-pharmacologic alternative for patients with AF.</p>
